evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: Because no evaluation existed for this setting, we build two domain benchmarks: a retrieval benchmark of 178 expert-annotated legal queries with gold provision spans, and an end-to-end benchmark of 504 expert-curated question--answer pairs scored by an LLM judge whose ratings we validate against human judgments and against an independent-family judge.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Deploying large language models for legal question answering raises challenges that general-purpose leaderboards do not capture, particularly for low-resource languages and under hard operational constraints.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
